source: World Play 1.1 design spec (docs/design/world-play-1.1-spec.md section 4, Leon 9 Nov 2026); PHC Core Rules v1.0, rules revision 1.9, World Play: Drop tables (spec 14 items 691-700)
provisional_note: Every number here is provisional (spec 14 items 691-700): the caps, the worn range, the rolls by tier, every weight and qty, the personal effects; qty_max, the most of one thing a loot entry gives (rules 1.54 item 8, Core Rules item 4111: the pack's quantity cap, a literal in lootToPack before).

personal_items.name: a ration tin with a Wick sticker
personal_items.text: Empty. Someone kept the tin for the sticker.

personal_items.name: a letter home, unsent
personal_items.text: Folded twice. It stops in the middle of a sentence.

personal_items.name: a Lumeri prayer card
personal_items.text: Thumbed soft at the corners; the saint's face is worn off.

personal_items.name: a photo of a family on a balcony
personal_items.text: Central City in the background. Everyone is squinting.

personal_items.name: a pocket EPCCG, Wick's smile scratched out
personal_items.text: Approved, internal use only. Someone disagreed with page one.

personal_items.name: a lucky round, never fired
personal_items.text: Its owner swore it had their name on it. It did, in marker.

personal_items.name: a Bazaim pawn ticket
personal_items.text: For a ring. The date to collect it has passed.

personal_items.name: a child's drawing of a robot
personal_items.text: It has a heart drawn on its chest and too many arms.

personal_items.name: a dog tag that isn't theirs
personal_items.text: Another name, another regiment. Kept on the same chain.

personal_items.name: a betting slip, never cashed
personal_items.text: A winner. They were saving it for a bad week.

personal_items.name: a lighter engraved "come home"
personal_items.text: It still lights on the third try.

personal_items.name: a pressed flower in a plastic sleeve
personal_items.text: From a world with a different sun; the colour is wrong for this one.

personal_items.name: a tin plate scratched with a tally of days
personal_items.text: Four hundred and twelve marks. The last one is half done.

personal_items.name: an IOU for a round of drinks
personal_items.text: Signed by three people. Two of the names are crossed out.

personal_items.name: a key to a door somewhere else
personal_items.text: No tag, no address. It is very well looked after.

personal_items.name: a cracked music chip
personal_items.text: It plays the first four seconds of a song, then hisses.

personal_items.name: a ward charm on a string
personal_items.text: Bone, wire and a bead. It didn't work.

personal_items.name: a love note in a private code
personal_items.text: Nobody else will ever read it. That was the point.

personal_items.name: half a deck of cards
personal_items.text: All the hearts are missing.

personal_items.name: a shuttle ticket stub to the Thousand-Planet City
personal_items.text: One way. Punched, so they went, and came back.

items.name: People
items.text: What a person carries: personal effects, rations, cigarettes, stims and the like.

items.name: Robots and drones
items.text: Parts and cores: they feed Field Repair, Crystallise and the Mind classes.

items.name: Casters
items.text: Mana cores, and rarely a heart or sigil plate.

items.name: Beasts
items.text: Nothing by default: a campaign or the Narrator adds trophies.

items.name: Notable (bosses)
items.text: One notable thing a boss always drops: a fine or masterwork weapon, a mod, an Essence of Experience, a plate.
